aggrid-error-load: Error message shown inside an AG Grid (as its overlay) when the grid's row data fails to load from the server.
aggrid-tracking-category: The name of the [[Special:TrackingCategories|tracking category]] for pages that render an AG Grid. See also {{msg-mw|aggrid-tracking-category-desc}}.
aggrid-tracking-category-desc: Description on [[Special:TrackingCategories]] for the {{msg-mw|aggrid-tracking-category}} tracking category.
aggrid-setfilter-search-placeholder: Placeholder text in the search box of a column's set filter, used to narrow a long list of values.
aggrid-setfilter-select-all: Label for the checkbox at the top of a set filter that selects or clears every value at once. Shown in parentheses to mark it apart from data values.
aggrid-setfilter-blanks: Label for the set-filter entry that groups rows whose cell is empty. Shown in parentheses to mark it apart from data values.
aggrid-setfilter-loading: Text shown in the set filter popup while the list of values is being fetched from the server.
aggrid-setfilter-partial: Note shown below the set-filter value list when the server returned only a partial list of values (e.g. capped for performance). Informs the user that not all possible values may be shown.
aggrid-setfilter-values-error: Error message shown in the set filter popup when fetching the list of values from the server failed.
aggrid-quicksearch-placeholder: Placeholder text in the quick-search box shown above a data grid when the page author enables the quickSearch grid option. Typing in the box filters the grid's rows across all columns.
aggrid-quicksearch-label: ARIA label (for screen readers) of the quick-search input shown above a data grid when the page author enables the quickSearch grid option.
aggrid-expand-label: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that opens a data grid in a full-window view, shown above the grid when the page author enables the expand grid option. Used while the grid is not expanded. See also {{msg-mw|aggrid-expand-collapse-label}}.
aggrid-expand-collapse-label: Accessible name and tooltip of the same button once the grid is expanded, when pressing it returns the grid to the page. See also {{msg-mw|aggrid-expand-label}}.
aggrid-expand-dialog-label: Accessible name of the dialog holding the expanded data grid, announced by screen readers when it opens.
